definitions.explanation: The act of moving a business, residence, or organization to a different location.
The legal transfer of ownership, rights, or title from one party to another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移転|いてん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company relocated to a new building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移転|いてん}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To complete the transfer of ownership procedures.

examples.japanese: {移転|いてん}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the address of the new location.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧{移転|いてん}⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: I registered the transfer of real estate ownership.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移転|いてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a plan to relocate the factory to a rural area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移転|いてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A legal procedure is necessary for the transfer of rights.

notes:
USAGE: Used for official or formal relocation of businesses, organizations, or legal transfers.

COMPOUNDS:
- {移転|いてん}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (new location/destination)
- {移転|いてん}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧ (notice of relocation)
- ⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧{移転|いてん} (transfer of ownership)
- ⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧{移転|いてん} (headquarters relocation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧ (moving - usually for personal/household moves)
- ⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧ (movement - more general)
- ⟦{移住|いじゅう}→移住：13752_ijuu⟧ (migration - for people changing residence)

NOTE: {移転|いてん} is more formal and often used for businesses and legal contexts.
